thread.old_title: This is my body, this is my blood of the new testament — the Passover kept and filled, the covenant cut with both houses (Exodus 12 and 24; Jeremiah 31; Isaiah 25)
thread.title: This is my body, this is my blood of the new testament — the Passover kept and filled, the covenant cut with both houses (Exodus 12 and 24; Jeremiah 31; Isaiah 25)
thread.old_summary:
It ain't new. The night he was betrayed he kept the Passover as Moses gave it, bread and cup at the table, and said what the bread and the cup were:

*And as they were eating, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.* (Matthew 26:26)

*For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.* (Matthew 26:28)

The meal was the feast Moses set for ever, not a new rite put in its place:

*And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to Yahuah (LORD) throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.* (Exodus 12:14)

Paul says the lamb of that feast is who was sacrificed, and the feast is still kept:

*Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Messiah (Christ) our passover is sacrificed for us:* (1 Corinthians 5:7)

*Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.* (1 Corinthians 5:8)

*My blood of the new testament*: a covenant is cut in blood, and the first one was. Moses sprinkled the people and said the same words over the same thing:

*And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) hath made with you concerning all these words.* (Exodus 24:8)

The new covenant is Jeremiah's, and Jeremiah names the parties. Not a church in place of a people, but the two houses of the one people, with the Torah written where it was always meant to live:

*Behold, the days come, saith Yahuah (LORD), that I will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and with the house of Yahudah (Judah):* (Jeremiah 31:31)

*But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, saith Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.* (Jeremiah 31:33)

The blood does what the Torah said blood does:

*For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.* (Leviticus 17:11)

And the one whose blood it is was named at the river before any of it:

*The next day John seeth Yahusha (Jesus) coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of Elohim (God), which taketh away the sin of the world.* (John 1:29)

He stops drinking the cup until a day he names:

*But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.* (Matthew 26:29)

That day is the feast on the mountain the prophet spread, and John saw the same supper from the other end:

*And in this mountain shall Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.* (Isaiah 25:6)

*And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of Elohim (God).* (Revelation 19:9)

A Passover kept, a covenant cut in blood as the first was, made with both houses, Torah on the heart, and a cup set down until the feast in the kingdom. Nothing at the table was done away; everything at the table was filled.

cards.note: Leviticus 16:1 — *And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before Yahuah (LORD), and died;* *And as they were eating, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.* (Matthew 26:26) In Leviticus 16 Aaron may come into the holy place only with blood and an offering. Yahuah (LORD) speaks to Moses about how the blood is to come near, and at the Passover table Yahusha (Jesus) speaks of his body and his blood. The Torah's way with blood is not set aside here. The supper stands in it.

cards.src_text: And as they were eating, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
cards.tgt_text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
cards.old_note: *For the life of the flesh is in the blood.*
cards.note: Leviticus 17:11 — *For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.* *And as they were eating, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.* (Matthew 26:26) Torah says what blood is for: the life is in it, and it makes atonement. When Yahusha (Jesus) calls the bread his body and goes on to speak of his blood, he speaks as Torah speaks. The blood is given *to make an atonement for your souls*, and the cup is no break from that.

cards.tgt_text: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) hath made with you concerning all these words.
cards.old_note: thread:last-supper-this-is-my-body-this-is-my-blood-of-the-new-testament | *Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (the LORD) hath made with you* (Shemot/Exodus 24:8).
cards.note: Exodus 24:8 — *And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) hath made with you concerning all these words.* *And as they did eat, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.* (Mark 14:22) Moses sprinkled the people and said *Behold the blood of the covenant*. At Mark's table Yahusha (Jesus) gives the bread as his body, and the cup that follows is spoken of the same way, so the supper stands in the covenant Moses cut and does not replace it.

cards.member_note: Exodus 24:8 — *Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) hath made with you.* Moses names the blood of the covenant over the people, the words the supper takes up again.

cards.src_text: And as they did eat, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
cards.tgt_text: Behold, the days come, saith Yahuah (LORD), that I will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and with the house of Yahudah (Judah):
cards.old_note: thread:last-supper-this-is-my-body-this-is-my-blood-of-the-new-testament | *This is my blood of the new testament.* The new covenant of Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31-34 carries its substance here — Torah written on the heart, made covenant in the blood of the Lamb.
cards.note: Jeremiah 31:31 — *Behold, the days come, saith Yahuah (LORD), that I will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and with the house of Yahudah (Judah):* *And as they did eat, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.* (Mark 14:22) Yahusha (Jesus) gives the bread as his body at a table where a new covenant is being named. Jeremiah says who it is made with: *the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* and *the house of Yahudah (Judah)*, the two houses of one people. It is made with them, not put in their place.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 11:23 — *For I have received of Yahusha (the Lord) that which also I delivered unto you, That Yahusha (the Lord Jesus) the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:* *And as they did eat, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.* (Mark 14:22) Paul passes on what Mark records. The night he was betrayed, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and Paul says he received this and gave it on. Two witnesses, one supper, the same night.
